item.title: Week 10: Ninety-Six Points of Separation
item.description: cbrech drops the week's high score on Cwmessi in a 96.66-point demolition, while rfrancella97 steals an upset from JoshWileczek, who left the winning points on his bench. Doc and Vinny break down the rookies and breakouts to watch, and the trade deadline arrives right now with a messy race for the 6 seed.
